supporting_pages.title: "How requests are handled \_|\_ App Engine standard environment \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: App Engine pending queue prioritization During periods of heavy traffic, App Engine might place requests in a pending queue while waiting for an available instance with the following prioritization: App Engine prioritizes other queued requests over pending queued requests from Task queue .

When a service receives standard HTTP traffic at high volume while also serving Task queue or Cloud Tasks traffic at much lower volume, there is a disproportionate impact on the latency of the Task queue or the Cloud Tasks traffic.
Requests from App Engine Cloud Tasks also share this pending queue priority behavior for compatibility reasons.
